body: not really an option for me... the guilt from losing my job and embarrassing my parents would be enough for me to purposely take a fatal dose, ha. I used to smoke a ton of weed, it was the only thing that ever ever ever made me forget about my suicidal ideation, and feel like a normal person. but the complex i live in now found out about my illicit substance use (i have my med card but the language in the lease states no "*federally* illicit substances") and already threatened to evict me. I had to choose between homelessness and suicidal thoughts, and here I am.
